subject: The secret setting 95% of users never discover
preview_text: I almost didn't include this in the app. It changes how the AI therapist talks to you. Most people miss it.
body_paragraphs: Okay, confession time. When I was building Fresh Start, I almost left out one tiny toggle in the settings. I thought it was too niche, too advanced. But the users who found it? They told me it made their healing feel 10x more personal. Like the app finally *got* them.

Here's the thing: the default AI therapist is great for general support. But what if you could make it talk exactly like you need? Not too soft, not too tough. The perfect balance for *your* specific heartbreak style. This one tweak tailors every single response—the journal prompts, the coping strategies, even the 3AM emergency mode—to match how you process pain.

It's buried in Settings > AI Therapist > Conversation Style. You can slide between 'Nurturing Guide' and 'Straight-Talk Friend.' Most people never touch it. But adjusting it? It's like unlocking a hidden layer of the app. The AI stops giving generic advice and starts speaking your unique emotional language.

Go tweak that slider right now. Just for 60 seconds. See if the next response feels different. I want you to have this insider edge. P.S. The users who do this have a 30% higher no-contact streak. It's that powerful.
